slides.label: Verse 1
lines: To the blessed Christ, our Lord

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: The ultimate reality embodied in You, Lord Jesus

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: With Your full and diverse wisdom
Are being revealed in us this day before every throne and rank
You are Eternal life manifested in us

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: There is no darkness in us at all
We are the offspring of the Word

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: You recreated us in Your righteousness
And we belong to You in that place of true holiness
We have been called into a glorious hope

slides.label: Verse 7
lines: As You are, oh Lord Jesus, so are we in this world
We are gods and children of the Most High
To execute the will of the Father

slides.label: Verse 8
lines: To the blessed Christ our Lord
